mentions.name: Neimr
mentions.description: A collaborative naming app with Tinder-style swiping: create a survey for baby names, pet names, business names, and more, invite a partner or friends, and it finds which names everyone agrees on. Built with Flutter and Firebase.
mentions.audience: Couples, friends, and groups deciding on names together
mentions.source_excerpt: Neimr — a collaborative naming app with Tinder-style swiping. Create a survey for baby names, pet names, business names, etc., invite your partner/friends, and it finds which names you all agree on. Built with Flutter + Firebase. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/neimr-swipe-find-names/id6758278121
